title: Command & Conquer 3: Kane's Wrath
notes: Campaign achievements come from your save games (Vault never touches the game, which has online play). The game saves automatically between missions; saving during a mission helps too.

Skirmish achievements come from the replay the game saves after every game (Documents\Command and Conquer 3 Kanes Wrath\Replays). Replays do not record who won, so these are about playing, not winning. Games shorter than 3 minutes do not count.

testGuide.title: Start the Nod campaign
testGuide.detail: Beat the first mission. When the game saves for the next mission, "Rio Insurrection" should pop.

testGuide.title: Play a skirmish
testGuide.detail: Play a skirmish for at least 3 minutes, then quit. "Into Battle" should pop.
